name: shader-swirl-lilac
title: Shader Swirl Lilac
description: Dreamy lilac and baby-blue swirl around a dark eye. A WebGL shader backdrop; the lilac preset of shader-swirl.
useWhen: A dreamy, soft swirl that stays out of the way of copy.
The frame is light, so dark foreground text and UI stay readable on top.
You want a finished Swirl look without tuning the palette and parameters yourself.
avoidWhen: The video must use your brand colors: start from `shader-swirl` and set `colors`.
You want a darker, contrasting mood from the same shader: use `shader-swirl-ember`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 10 colors, comma separated, for the bands from the outside in.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Color behind and between the bands.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the bands spin. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Bands
variables.description: How many bands wind around the center.

variables.label: Twist
variables.description: How strongly the bands curl toward the center.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: How softly the bands blend. 0 gives hard edges.

variables.label: Center
variables.description: Size of the clear area around the center point.

variables.label: Proportion
variables.description: Balance between the first color and the rest.

variables.label: Noise
variables.description: Amount of noise that roughens the bands.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the pattern in or out.

variables.label: Offset X
variables.description: Moves the pattern sideways, in frame widths.

variables.label: Offset Y
variables.description: Moves the pattern up or down, in frame heights.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster but softens fine detail.
